# Known-good CLAUDE.md fixture

Technical writing that resembles a violation but isn't one. The gate must
report nothing here, or it would block legitimate edits to CLAUDE.md.

- Pin exact versions: react@18.3.1, @tanstack/react-query@5.62.0, gitleaks/v8@v8.30.1.
- In the awk step, $1 is the package and $2 its coverage; sed uses \1 and $1 alike.
- The OIDC provider registers ex as a confidential client.
- Run the app and open http://localhost:8080.
- See https://github.com/redis/go-redis and https://pkg.go.dev/net/http for details.
- Examples use ops@example.com and https://chat.example.com/channel/general.
- Loopback is 127.0.0.1; the listener binds 0.0.0.0.
- Timeouts: 30s detached work, 10 min attention window, 2 min suppression.
